title: LUNA theory-driven eight-candidate family — full persisted monthly series

cost_model.turnover_definition: 1 - overlap(current_top20, prior_month_top20)/20; first formation month turnover = 1
cost_model.explanation: 20/30/40 bps applies per 1.0 unit of portfolio turnover, not per symbol trade.

outcome_policy: Rank and fix the portfolio using formation-date factors only. If any selected security lacks a valid next-calendar-month adjusted close, that month has no return and the candidate is incomplete; rank 21 is never substituted.
notes: September 2026 formation is outside the declared evaluation horizon because the panel has no next-calendar-month return observation.
Current Supabase returns are keyed by formula_id and month, not directly by run_id; the experiment config maps formula IDs to the family run ID.
All candidates are exploratory and PAPER_SHADOW_ONLY because the universe is survivor-oriented and PIT membership is unverified.
2024-09 to 2025-08 is retrospective; 2025-09 onward is post-hoc. Neither is a virgin holdout.
